subject: Routine reversible step before the rundown — Lisa's temporary reset (HD-4480)
body:
Hi — one step before the rundown (item 3, after Raj's VPN and Elena's badge): Lisa Chen's lockout. This is routine, non-destructive, and fully reversible — it's a temporary password she can re-reset anytime, and nothing is exposed or escalated.
